required_scopes.obligation: Independent review of versioned purpose, voluntariness, timing opt-out, withdrawal and consent instructions.
Separate owner and applicable institutional authorization bound to exact protocol and task set.
Approved encrypted supervised storage, restricted access and backup policy; local permissions alone are insufficient.
Approve frozen raw 30-day and approved aggregate 90-day maximum retention after closure; assign coordinator and dates.
Approve batch-wide withdrawal deletion within 7 days and backup deletion within 30 days; independently inspect real-data handling before recruitment.
Independently confirm voluntary eligible adults and conflict/power-relationship safeguards without recording identities here.
Approve minimization, small-cell suppression, consented disclosure and publication restrictions; pseudonyms are not anonymity.
